newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Lone Star expects Awak Mas gold update.
newsitem.headline: Lone Star expects Awak Mas gold update.

text.p: Lone Star Exploration NL said on Monday it expects to release an updated resource figure later this week on its Awak Mas gold prospect in Indonesia.
The udate will take into account about 25,000 metres of drilling since the previous resouce figure was made public last January, Frank Campagna, Lone Star's company secretary, told Reuters.
The January report showed an indicated resource of 1.80 million ounces of gold, at a one gram a tonne cut off.
The project, 45 percent owned by Lone Star, is situated on the south of Sulawesi Island.
Gasgoyne Gold Mines NL also holds a 45 percent interest in Awak Mas. The remaining 10 precent is owned by PT Asminco Bara Utama of Indonesia.
Lone Star is also listed on the Vancouver Stock Exchange under the symbol.
